Platinum Kaizo trainers split by split, in the order of the Platinum Kaizo Docs sheet, with its sprites and badges. The column left of each team holds the trainer’s AI flags, laid out as the doc lays them out; the key at the top of each split names every icon. A red dot holds a note: the doc’s own note, and what that fight’s conditions mean (fog, weather, Trick Room, tag battles, gauntlets).

Fantina Split

42 battles

AI Flag KeyBasic!A basic set of protocols that almost all trainers in Platinum Kaizo use.Eval Att!A basic protocol that checks the effectiveness of an attackExpert!An advanced set of protocols that most trainers in Platinum Kaizo use.Status!On the first turn of the battle, Prioritize certain Setup, Status, and Entry Hazard moves.Risky!50% of the time, Prioritize risky attacks, such as OHKO moves, High-crit moves, Explosion, and Omni-boosts.Damage Prio!40% of the time, All damaging moves are prioritized over non-damaging moves.Baton Pass!Swords Dance, Calm Mind, Nasty Plot, and Dragon Dance are more likely to be used at High HP, and Baton Pass's priority increases the higher their offensive stats are.Tag AI!A list of Tag-Battle focused routines, such as using Earthquake more often when the partner is unaffected by Ground-Type moves.Check HP!Discourages some moves at certain HP ranges.Weather!On the first turn of the battle, the AI will almost certainly use a Weather move if they have one.Harassment!In Double Battles, the AI will prioritize moves that harass the player, such as Status moves, Debuff moves, and Entry hazards.Left Side AI!During a Double Battle, the opponents right side will function normally. However, the left side will act wild and unpredictably. (But not completely random!)

Maylene Split

37 battles

AI Flag KeyBasic!A basic set of protocols that almost all trainers in Platinum Kaizo use.Eval Att!A basic protocol that checks the effectiveness of an attackExpert!An advanced set of protocols that most trainers in Platinum Kaizo use.Status!On the first turn of the battle, Prioritize certain Setup, Status, and Entry Hazard moves.Risky!50% of the time, Prioritize risky attacks, such as OHKO moves, High-crit moves, Explosion, and Omni-boosts.Damage Prio!40% of the time, All damaging moves are prioritized over non-damaging moves.Baton Pass!Swords Dance, Calm Mind, Nasty Plot, and Dragon Dance are more likely to be used at High HP, and Baton Pass's priority increases the higher their offensive stats are.Tag AI!A list of Tag-Battle focused routines, such as using Earthquake more often when the partner is unaffected by Ground-Type moves.Check HP!Discourages some moves at certain HP ranges.Weather!On the first turn of the battle, the AI will almost certainly use a Weather move if they have one.Harassment!In Double Battles, the AI will prioritize moves that harass the player, such as Status moves, Debuff moves, and Entry hazards.Left Side AI!During a Double Battle, the opponents right side will function normally. However, the left side will act wild and unpredictably. (But not completely random!)

AI Flag KeyBasic!A basic set of protocols that almost all trainers in Platinum Kaizo use.Eval Att!A basic protocol that checks the effectiveness of an attackExpert!An advanced set of protocols that most trainers in Platinum Kaizo use.Status!On the first turn of the battle, Prioritize certain Setup, Status, and Entry Hazard moves.Risky!50% of the time, Prioritize risky attacks, such as OHKO moves, High-crit moves, Explosion, and Omni-boosts.Damage Prio!40% of the time, All damaging moves are prioritized over non-damaging moves.Baton Pass!Swords Dance, Calm Mind, Nasty Plot, and Dragon Dance are more likely to be used at High HP, and Baton Pass's priority increases the higher their offensive stats are.Tag AI!A list of Tag-Battle focused routines, such as using Earthquake more often when the partner is unaffected by Ground-Type moves.Check HP!Discourages some moves at certain HP ranges.Weather!On the first turn of the battle, the AI will almost certainly use a Weather move if they have one.Harassment!In Double Battles, the AI will prioritize moves that harass the player, such as Status moves, Debuff moves, and Entry hazards.Left Side AI!During a Double Battle, the opponents right side will function normally. However, the left side will act wild and unpredictably. (But not completely random!)

Byron Split

70 battles

AI Flag KeyBasic!A basic set of protocols that almost all trainers in Platinum Kaizo use.Eval Att!A basic protocol that checks the effectiveness of an attackExpert!An advanced set of protocols that most trainers in Platinum Kaizo use.Status!On the first turn of the battle, Prioritize certain Setup, Status, and Entry Hazard moves.Risky!50% of the time, Prioritize risky attacks, such as OHKO moves, High-crit moves, Explosion, and Omni-boosts.Damage Prio!40% of the time, certain damaging moves are prioritized.Baton Pass!Swords Dance, Calm Mind, Nasty Plot, and Dragon Dance are more likely to be used at High HP, and Baton Pass's priority increases the higher their offensive stats are.Tag AI!A list of Tag-Battle focused routines, such as using Earthquake more often when the partner is unaffected by Ground-Type moves.Check HP!Discourages some moves at certain HP ranges.Weather!On the first turn of the battle, the AI will almost certainly use a Weather move if they have one.Harassment!In Double Battles, the AI will prioritize moves that harass the player, such as Status moves, Debuff moves, and Entry hazards.Left Side AI!During a Double Battle, the opponents right side will function normally. However, the left side will act wild and unpredictably. (But not completely random!)

Clamberclaw Cliffs!Features a permanent fog environment in which Defog removes the accuracy-lowering effect when used *in battle*.

Galactic♀ Luna (FOG)!Fog: every move's accuracy is multiplied by 3/5, so a 100% move hits 60% of the time and a 90% move 54% (moves that can't miss, like Swift, are unaffected). Weather Ball's power doubles (it stays Normal type), SolarBeam's power is halved, and Moonlight, Synthesis and Morning Sun heal only 1/4 of max HP. Using Defog in battle clears it.

AI Flag KeyBasic!A basic set of protocols that almost all trainers in Platinum Kaizo use.Eval Att!A basic protocol that checks the effectiveness of an attackExpert!An advanced set of protocols that most trainers in Platinum Kaizo use.Status!On the first turn of the battle, Prioritize certain Setup, Status, and Entry Hazard moves.Risky!50% of the time, Prioritize risky attacks, such as OHKO moves, High-crit moves, Explosion, and Omni-boosts.Damage Prio!40% of the time, All damaging moves are prioritized over non-damaging moves.Baton Pass!Swords Dance, Calm Mind, Nasty Plot, and Dragon Dance are more likely to be used at High HP, and Baton Pass's priority increases the higher their offensive stats are.Tag AI!A list of Tag-Battle focused routines, such as using Earthquake more often when the partner is unaffected by Ground-Type moves.Check HP!Discourages some moves at certain HP ranges.Weather!On the first turn of the battle, the AI will almost certainly use a Weather move if they have one.Harassment!In Double Battles, the AI will prioritize moves that harass the player, such as Status moves, Debuff moves, and Entry hazards.Left Side AI!During a Double Battle, the opponents right side will function normally. However, the left side will act wild and unpredictably. (But not completely random!)

AI Flag KeyBasic!A basic set of protocols that almost all trainers in Platinum Kaizo use.Eval Att!A basic protocol that checks the effectiveness of an attackExpert!An advanced set of protocols that most trainers in Platinum Kaizo use.Status!On the first turn of the battle, Prioritize certain Setup, Status, and Entry Hazard moves.Risky!50% of the time, Prioritize risky attacks, such as OHKO moves, High-crit moves, Explosion, and Omni-boosts.Damage Prio!40% of the time, All damaging moves are prioritized over non-damaging moves.Baton Pass!Swords Dance, Calm Mind, Nasty Plot, and Dragon Dance are more likely to be used at High HP, and Baton Pass's priority increases the higher their offensive stats are.Tag AI!A list of Tag-Battle focused routines, such as using Earthquake more often when the partner is unaffected by Ground-Type moves.Check HP!Discourages some moves at certain HP ranges.Weather!On the first turn of the battle, the AI will almost certainly use a Weather move if they have one.Harassment!In Double Battles, the AI will prioritize moves that harass the player, such as Status moves, Debuff moves, and Entry hazards.Left Side AI!During a Double Battle, the opponents right side will function normally. However, the left side will act wild and unpredictably. (But not completely random!)

AI Flag KeyBasic!A basic set of protocols that almost all trainers in Platinum Kaizo use.Eval Att!A basic protocol that checks the effectiveness of an attackExpert!An advanced set of protocols that most trainers in Platinum Kaizo use.Status!On the first turn of the battle, Prioritize certain Setup, Status, and Entry Hazard moves.Risky!50% of the time, Prioritize risky attacks, such as OHKO moves, High-crit moves, Explosion, and Omni-boosts.Damage Prio!40% of the time, All damaging moves are prioritized over non-damaging moves.Baton Pass!Swords Dance, Calm Mind, Nasty Plot, and Dragon Dance are more likely to be used at High HP, and Baton Pass's priority increases the higher their offensive stats are.Tag AI!A list of Tag-Battle focused routines, such as using Earthquake more often when the partner is unaffected by Ground-Type moves.Check HP!Discourages some moves at certain HP ranges.Weather!On the first turn of the battle, the AI will almost certainly use a Weather move if they have one.Harassment!In Double Battles, the AI will prioritize moves that harass the player, such as Status moves, Debuff moves, and Entry hazards.Left Side AI!During a Double Battle, the opponents right side will function normally. However, the left side will act wild and unpredictably. (But not completely random!)
